8800.meaning1: paying improper attention; applying attention in the wrong way; imprudently applying the mind
8800.meaningLit: not making the source in mind
8800.commentary: (SNa) ayonisomanasikāro'ti anupāyamanasikāro uppathamanasikāro anicce niccan'ti vā, dukkhe sukhan'ti, anattani att'ti vā, asubhe subhan'ti vā, manasikāro.
8800.notes: See ayoni for an example of the idiomatic use of yoni.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannā vā vicikicchā uppajjati uppannā vā vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ayonisomanasikāro
tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā kāmacchandassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā kāmacchandassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.

8801.meaning1: frequent improper attention; regular practice of careless attention; lots of imprudent use of the mind
8801.commentary: (SNa) ayonisomanasikāro'ti anupāyamanasikāro uppathamanasikāro anicce niccan'ti vā, dukkhe sukhan'ti, anattani att'ti vā, asubhe subhan'ti vā, manasikāro. taṃ tasmiṃ subhārammaṇe bahulaṃ pavattayato kāmacchando uppajjati.

examples.text: ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā kāmacchandassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā kāmacchandassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.

8802.meaning2: which is so called improper attention

8803.meaning1: source of radical inattention; arising of unwise reflection

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ, yaṃ balavā puriso tattena ayopaṭṭena ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena kāyaṃ sampaliveṭheyya, yaṃ vā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ vā brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ vā gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā saddhādeyyaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjeyyā'ti?
patto nāma dve pattā ayopatto mattikāpatto'ti.
catukkaṇṇo catudvāro, vibhatto bhāgaso mito, ayopākārapariyanto, ayasā paṭikujjito.
jālena ca onahiyāna, tattha hananti ayomayakuṭebhi, andhaṃ'va timisam'āyanti, taṃ vitatañ'hi yathā mahikāyo.
sataṃ āsi ayosaṅkū, sabbe paccattavedanā, īdiso nirayo āsi, yattha dūsī apaccatha.
varaṃ, bhikkhave, tiṇhena ayosaṅkunā ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena sot'indriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva sotaviññeyyesu saddesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.

katamo ca, bhikkhave, ādittapariyāyo, dhammapariyāyo? varaṃ, bhikkhave, tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya cakkhu'ndriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.

seyyathā'pi nāma purisassa ayosiṅghāṭakaṃ kaṇṭhe vilaggaṃ, so n'eva sakkuṇeyya uggilituṃ na sakkuṇeyya ogilituṃ. evam'eva kho te, rājakumāra, samaṇo gotamo imaṃ ubhatokoṭikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno n'eva sakkhiti uggilituṃ na sakkhiti ogilitun'ti.
sā ayyassa ānandassa pāde sirasā vandatī'ti. evañ'ca vadehi, sādhu kira, bhante, ayyo ānando yena bhikkhun'upassayo yena sā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti.
tena kho pana samayena maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti. atha kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi taṃ parisaṃ etadavoca, mā ayyā evaṃ avacuttha.
mātā putto pitā bhātā, ayyakā ca pure ahuṃ, yathābhuccam'ajānantī, saṃsariṃ'haṃ anibbisaṃ.

8819.meaning1: young gentleman; noble son; master's son

examples.text: sace'pi me ayyaputtā vesāliṃ sāhāraṃ dajjeyyātha n'eva dajjāhaṃ taṃ bhattan'ti
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, bārāṇasiyaṃ aññatarassa chapakassa pajāpati gabbhinī ahosi. atha kho, bhikkhave, sā chapakī taṃ chapakaṃ etadavoca, gabbhinī'mhi, ayyaputta!
kiṃ nu kho me ayyā santaṃ'y'eva nu kho ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti udāhu asantaṃ udāhu mayham'ev'ete kamm'antā susaṃvihitā yena me ayyā santaṃ'y'eva ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti, no asantaṃ?
atha naṃ, idaṃ sītalaṃ bhavissatī'ti kaṭacchuṃ pūretvā ādāya āgacchantiṃ uttarāya dāsiyo disvā, apehi dubbinīte, na tvaṃ amhākaṃ ayyāya pakkuthitaṃ sappiṃ āsiñcituṃ anucchavikā'ti.
gāmavarena ce'p'āhaṃ bhante, labheyyaṃ mā me ayyikā kālam'akāsī'ti, gāmavaram'p'āhaṃ dadeyyaṃ, mā me ayyikā kālam'akāsī'ti.

pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi ayyirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsakammakarā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, yathābalaṃ kamm'antasaṃvidhānena bhattavetan'ānuppadānena gilān'upaṭṭhānena acchariyānaṃ rasānaṃ saṃvibhāgena samaye vossaggena.

8828.grammar: fem, voc sg and pl of ayyā
8828.meaning1: polite address to a woman; mistress; lady; ladies; madam; mesdames

examples.text: he je kāḷī'ti. kiṃ, ayye'ti? kiṃ, je, divā uṭṭhāsī'ti?
anujānāhi me ayye, icche sāvatthi gantave, sīhanādaṃ nadissāmi, buddhaseṭṭhassa santike.
idh'ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa tadah'uposathe pannarase sīsaṃ nhātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pāturahosi sahassa-araṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ.
heṭṭhā kho pana tassa bhoto gotamassa pādatalesu cakkāni jātāni sahassa-arāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabb'ākāraparipūrāni
cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanā adantā aguttā arakkhitā asaṃvutā dukkh'ādhivāhā honti. katame cha? cakkhu, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanaṃ adantaṃ aguttaṃ arakkhitaṃ asaṃvutaṃ dukkh'ādhivāhaṃ hoti

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati arakkhiten'eva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya arakkhitena cittena, anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā, asaṃvutehi indriyehi.
tassa arakkhita-kāyakamm'antassa arakkhita-vacīkamm'antassa arakkhita-manokamm'antassa kāyakammam'pi avassutaṃ hoti, vacīkammam'pi avassutaṃ hoti, manokammam'pi avassutaṃ hoti.
tassa arakkhita-kāyakamm'antassa arakkhita-vacīkamm'antassa arakkhita-manokamm'antassa kāyakammam'pi avassutaṃ hoti, vacīkammam'pi avassutaṃ hoti, manokammam'pi avassutaṃ hoti.
tassa arakkhita-kāyakamm'antassa arakkhita-vacīkamm'antassa arakkhita-manokamm'antassa kāyakammam'pi avassutaṃ hoti, vacīkammam'pi avassutaṃ hoti, manokammam'pi avassutaṃ hoti.

8838.meaning1: which need not be hidden (by); unnecessary to protect (for)
8838.commentary: (DNa) arakkheyyānī'ti na rakkhitabbāni. tīsu dvāresu paccekaṃ rakkhaṇakiccaṃ n'atthi, sabbāni satiyā eva rakkhitānī'ti dīpeti.

examples.text: tīṇi tathāgatassa arakkheyyāni, parisuddhakāyasamācāro āvuso tathāgato, n'atthi tathāgatassa kāyaduccaritaṃ, yaṃ tathāgato rakkheyya, mā me idaṃ paro aññāsī'ti.

8840.construction:
na > a + √raj + as + a
arajas + a

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ākāse vividhā vātā vāyanti. puratthimā'pi vātā vāyanti, pacchimā'pi vātā vāyanti, uttarā'pi vātā vāyanti, dakkhiṇā'pi vātā vāyanti, sarajā'pi vātā vāyanti, arajā'pi vātā vāyanti, sītā'pi vātā vāyanti, uṇhā'pi vātā vāyanti, parittā'pi vātā vāyanti, adhimattā'pi vātā vāyanti.

8841.meaning2: not liking; not taking pleasure; not delighting

8842.meaning2: not finding pleasure (in); not being attracted (to)

8844.commentary: (MNa) araññan'ti nikkhamitvā bahi indakhīlā, sabbam'etaṃ araññan'ti (VIN 1.1.2) araññaṃ nāma ṭhapetvā gāmañ'ca gām'ūpacārañ'ca avasesaṃ araññaṃ nāma.

examples.text: ramaṇīyāni araññāni, yattha na ramatī jano, vītarāgā ramissanti, na te kāmagavesino.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso araññe pavane caramāno passeyya purāṇaṃ maggaṃ purāṇ'añjasaṃ pubbakehi manussehi anuyātaṃ.

8845.meaning2: belonging to or living in a forest

8846.meaning1: small forest hut; little forest shack; cabin in the woods
8846.commentary: (MNa) araññakuṭikāyan'ti tass'eva veḷuvanassa ekasmiṃ vivittaṭṭhāne padhānakammikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ atthāya katasen'āsane. (SNa) araññakuṭikāyan'ti tass'eva vihārassa paccante paṇṇasālāyaṃ. (SNa) araññakuṭikāyan'ti araññe katāya pāṭiyekkāya kuṭiyaṃ, na vihārapaccantakuṭiyaṃ. (UDa) araññakuṭikāyan'ti sālapantiyā avidūre rukkhagacchasañchannaṭṭhāne katā kuṭikā, taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ araññakuṭikāyaṃ viharatī'ti.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā bhikkhū, kosalesu viharanti himavantapasse araññakuṭikāya uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākat'indriyā.

8847.meaning1: gone to the forest; gone to the woods

examples.text: katamā c'āvuso, suññatā cetovimutti? idh'āvuso, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññ'āgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati, suññam'idaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā'ti. ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, suññatā cetovimutti.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññ'āgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā

8848.meaning1: in the forest; in the woods

examples.text: adinn'ādāyī hoti. yaṃ taṃ parassa paravitt'ūpakaraṇaṃ gāmagataṃ vā araññagataṃ vā taṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādātā hoti.

8850.commentary: (VIN) araññaṃ nāma yaṃ manussānaṃ pariggahitaṃ hoti, taṃ araññaṃ. araññaṭṭhaṃ nāma bhaṇḍaṃ araññe catūhi ṭhānehi nikkhittaṃ hoti, bhūmaṭṭhaṃ, thalaṭṭhaṃ, ākāsaṭṭhaṃ, vehāsaṭṭhaṃ.

examples.text: araññaṃ nāma yaṃ manussānaṃ pariggahitaṃ hoti, taṃ araññaṃ. araññaṭṭhaṃ nāma bhaṇḍaṃ araññe catūhi ṭhānehi nikkhittaṃ hoti, bhūmaṭṭhaṃ, thalaṭṭhaṃ, ākāsaṭṭhaṃ, vehāsaṭṭhaṃ.

8851.commentary: (MNa) araññaṃ araññabhūtan'ti agāmakaṃ araññam'eva hutvā araññaṃ jātaṃ.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, sutaṃ te daṇḍakī'raññaṃ kāliṅg'āraññaṃ majjh'āraññaṃ mātaṅg'āraññaṃ araññaṃ araññabhūtan'ti?

8852.meaning1: perception of forest; concept of wilderness
8852.commentary: (MNa) araññasaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattan'ti idaṃ araññaṃ, ayaṃ rukkho, ayaṃ pabbato, ayaṃ nīl'obhāso vanasaṇḍo'ti evaṃ ekaṃ araññaṃ'y'eva paṭicca araññasaññaṃ manasi karoti.

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, ye assu darathā gāmasaññaṃ paṭicca te'dha na santi, ye assu darathā manussasaññaṃ paṭicca te'dha na santi, atthi c'ev'āyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ, araññasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan'ti.

puna caparaṃ, ambaṭṭha, idh'ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā imañ'c'eva anuttaraṃ vijjācaraṇasampadaṃ anabhisambhuṇamāno pavattaphalabhojanatañ'ca anabhisambhuṇamāno kudālapiṭakaṃ ādāya araññavanaṃ ajjhogāhati, kandamūlaphalabhojano bhavissāmī'ti.
dv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, atthavase sampassamāno araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevāmi. katame dve? attano ca diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ sampassamāno, pacchimañ'ca janataṃ anukampamāno.

catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu n'ālaṃ araññavanappatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevituṃ. katamehi catūhi? kāmavitakkena, byāpādavitakkena, vihiṃsāvitakkena, duppañño hoti jaḷo elamūgo
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, araññ'āyatane mahāsarasī. taṃ nāgā upanissāya viharanti. te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbuhetvā suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā akaddamaṃ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.
tatrāssu me idaṃ, sāriputta, pavivittasmiṃ hoti, so kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, aññataraṃ araññ'āyatanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā viharāmi.

8865.meaningLit: discourse on seers in the wilderness area

8866.meaning2: destroyed country; lit. not a country

examples.text: imasmiṃ kira jātake bodhisatto koṇḍadamako ahosi. so ten'eva paratantiyuttabhāvena jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpuṇi. devatā kujjhitvā sakalam'eva majjharaṭṭhaṃ uṇhaṃ kukkuḷavassaṃ vassāpetvā raṭṭhaṃ araṭṭham'akaṃsu.

8867.meaning1: harmless; benign; peaceful; not conflicting; (comm) without defilements

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, yam'idaṃ ataramānassa bhāsitaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho, sammāpaṭipadā. tasmā eso dhammo araṇo.
samaṇ'īdha araṇā loke, samaṇānaṃ vusitaṃ na nassati, samaṇā icchaṃ parijānanti, samaṇānaṃ bhojissiyaṃ sadā

8869.meaning1: way of non-conflict; harmless way; peaceful path

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, saraṇañ'ca dhammaṃ jānissāma, araṇañ'ca dhammaṃ jānissāma, saraṇañ'ca dhammaṃ ñatvā araṇañ'ca dhammaṃ ñatvā araṇapaṭipadaṃ paṭipajjissāmā'ti evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.
bhadante'ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca, araṇavibhaṅgaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi.

8872.meaningLit: discourse on the detailed analysis of non-conflict

8873.meaning1: living without conflict; dwelling harmlessly; (comm) living without defilement
8873.commentary: (ANa) araṇavihārīnan'ti nikkilesavihārīnaṃ. raṇan'ti hi rāg'ādayo kilesā vuccanti, tesaṃ abhāvena nikkilesavihāro araṇavihāro nāma. so yesaṃ atthi, te araṇavihārino. tesaṃ araṇavihārīnaṃ subhūtitthero aggo'ti.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ araṇavihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ subhūti.

8874.meaning2: piece of wood for kindling fire by friction

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ udake nikkhittaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya uttara-araṇiṃ ādāya, aggiṃ abhinibbattessāmi, tejo pātukarissāmī'ti.

8875.meaning1: tool for kindling fire; fire bow
8875.meaning2: one of the tools for kindling fire

examples.text: anāpatti gaṇṭhikāya, araṇike, vidhe, añjaniyā, añjanisalākāya, vāsijaṭe, udakapuñchaniyā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

8876.meaning2: rubbing of two sticks in order to kindle fire

8877.meaning1: kindling stick and base; fire making kit

examples.text: tassa pekkhamānassa araṇisahitaṃ gahetvā aggiṃ nibbattetvā taṃ dārakaṃ etadavoca, evaṃ kho, tāta, aggi nibbattetabbo.
āyatanaghaṭṭanato phasso jāyati araṇisahit'ābhimanthanato aggi viya. phassena phuṭṭhassa vedanā pātubhavati agginā phuṭṭhassa dāho viya. vedayamānassa taṇhā pavaḍḍhati loṇ'ūdakaṃ pivato pipāsā viya.
atthassā'ti ñeyyassa, ñeyyañ'hi ñāṇena araṇīyato, attho'ti vuccati.
attho'ti paṭipadā, yaṃ vā kiñci attano hitaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ araṇīyato attho'ti vuccati, araṇīyato nāma upagantabbato.

8880.meaning2: to be served, to be honoured

8881.grammar: fem, abstr, from na rati, neg (+dat)
8881.meaning1: dissatisfaction; dislike; discontent; aversion; boredom (towards); ennui (with)
8881.commentary: (SNa) aratī'ti ukkaṇṭhitā. (VIBH) tattha katamā arati? pantesu vā sen'āsanesu aññatar'aññataresu vā adhikusalesu dhammesu arati aratitā anabhirati anabhiramaṇā ukkaṇṭhitā paritassitā, ayaṃ vuccati arati.

examples.text: muditaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. muditañ'hi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato yā arati sā pahīyissati.
paññaṃ purakkhatvā kalyāṇapīti, vikkhambhaye tāni parissayāni, aratiṃ sahetha sayanamhi pante, caturo sahetha paridevadhamme.

8882.meaning1: name of one of the three daughters of Death
8882.commentary: (DHPa) ath'assa taṇhā aratī ragā'ti imā tisso dhītaro

examples.text: disvāna taṇhaṃ aratiṃ ragañ'ca, n'āhosi chando api methunasmiṃ, kim'ev'idaṃ muttakarīsapuṇṇaṃ, pādā'pi naṃ samphusituṃ na icche.
atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro yena māro pāpimā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu.

8883.meaning1: disliking and liking; aversion and craving; dissatisfaction and delight

examples.text: aratiratisaho assaṃ, na ca maṃ aratirati saheyya, uppannaṃ aratiratiṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyyan'ti

8884.meaning1: who overcomes aversion and craving; who beats dissatisfaction and delight
8884.commentary: (MNa) aratiratisaho assan'ti aratiyā ratiyā ca saho abhibhavitā ajjhottharitā bhaveyyaṃ.

examples.text: aratiratisaho assaṃ, na ca maṃ aratirati saheyya, uppannaṃ aratiratiṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyyan'ti
aratiratisaho hoti, na ca taṃ arati sahati, uppannaṃ aratiṃ abhibhuyya viharati.

8887.meaning1: overcoming discontent; enduring dissatisfaction; conquering boredom; (or) overcoming Māra's daughter
8887.commentary: (ANa) dhīro hi aratissaho'ti aratisahattā hi so dhīro nāma, tasmā aratiṃ sahatī'ti attho.

examples.text: n'ārati sahati dhīraṃ, n'ārati dhīraṃ sahati, dhīro'va aratiṃ sahati, dhīro hi aratissaho.

8888.meaning1: who is dissatisfied; who is discontent
8888.construction:
na > a + √ram + ti + vant
arati + vant

examples.text: yena kho, jīvaka, rāgena yena dosena yena mohena vihesavā assa arativā assa paṭighavā assa so rāgo so doso so moho tathāgatassa pahīno ucchinnamūlo tāl'āvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
niddā tandī vijambhitā, aratī bhattasammado, etena nappakāsati, ariyamaggo idha pāṇinan'ti.
anagho ve ahaṃ yakkha, atho nandī na vijjati, atho maṃ ekam'āsīnaṃ, aratī n'ābhikīratī'ti.

8890.meaning1: name of a teacher of old

8891.meaning1: tasteless; lacking in taste; without sophistication
8891.commentary: (ANa) arasarūpo bhavaṃ gotamo'ti. ayaṃ kir'assa adhippāyo, yaṃ loke abhivādana-paccuṭṭhāna-añjalikamma-sāmīcikammaṃ sāmaggiraso'ti vuccati, taṃ bhoto gotamassa n'atthi. tasmā arasarūpo bhavaṃ gotamo, arasajātiko arasasabhāvo'ti.

examples.text: arasarūpo bhavaṃ gotamo'ti
ayaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya, arasarūpo samaṇo gotamo'ti, no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesī'ti
aṭṭhahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhaddo ass'ājānīyo rāja-araho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgan't'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. katamehi aṭṭhahi?
chanda-arahānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ chandaparisuddhi-āhāraṇaṃ kataṃ kiṃ? chandaparisuddhi-āhāraṇaṃ idha n'atthi.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: sudhotarajapacchadaṃ subhaṃ, goṇakatūlikasanthataṃ navaṃ, abhiruha sayanaṃ mahā-arahaṃ, candanamaṇḍita-sāragandhikaṃ.

8896.meaning1: directed towards what is valuable; considering what is worthy; (comm) to the triple gem
8896.meaning2: directed towards arahants; (or directed towards the worthy)
8896.commentary: (ANa) arahaggatan'ti sabbasakkārānaṃ arahe ratanattay'eva gataṃ, tīsu vatthūsu garucittīkāraṃ upaṭṭhapethā'ti attho.

examples.text: adhisīle samādapeti, dhammadassane niveseti, gilānake upasaṅkamitvā satiṃ uppādeti, arahaggataṃ āyasmanto satiṃ upaṭṭhāpethā'ti…
yo sāsanaṃ arahataṃ, ariyānaṃ dhammajīvinaṃ, paṭikkosati dummedho, diṭṭhiṃ nissāya pāpikaṃ, phalāni kaṭṭhakass'eva, attaghātāya phallati.
khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti abbhaññāsi. aññataro ca pan'āyasmā soṇo arahataṃ ahosi.

8899.grammar: masc, instr sg of arahant, irreg

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, āvuso, abbhutaṃ, āvuso! yāvañ'c'idaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sambādhe okās'ādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.
vuttañ'h'etaṃ bhagavatā, vuttam'arahatā'ti me sutaṃ.
